description: Get the current weather for a city by name or by latitude/longitude.

lat.description: Optional latitude (used with lon if q is not provided).

lon.description: Optional longitude (used with lat if q is not provided).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the OpenWeather current-weather payload; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get the multi-step forecast for a city by name or by latitude/longitude.

lat.description: Optional latitude (used with lon if q is not provided).

lon.description: Optional longitude (used with lat if q is not provided).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the OpenWeather forecast payload (cod, cnt, list, city); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Geocode a place name to matching cities with coordinates.

q.description: The place name query to geocode.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-10, default 5).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of matching locations (name, lat, lon, country, state).
